application_credentials.description: SolarEdge uses OAuth 2.0 (Site Access). Sign in to the [SolarEdge developer console]({developer_url}) with your SolarEdge account, create a **Site Access** application for the Monitoring API with the scopes {scopes}, and register `{redirect_url}` as redirect URI. This URL is based on the Home Assistant URL configured under Settings > System > Network (external URL, or the internal URL when there is none), and your browser must be able to reach it. Then enter the client ID and client secret of that application here.

credit_limit_reached.title: SolarEdge API credit limit reached
credit_limit_reached.description: The monthly credit limit of your SolarEdge developer account is reached, so no data is updated until the next billing cycle. Lower the monthly credit budget in the integration options so the update interval becomes longer, or upgrade your tier in the SolarEdge developer console.

power_flow_tier.title: SolarEdge power flow not available
power_flow_tier.description: The Advanced power flow API is not available for your SolarEdge developer account ({detail}). It requires the Business Pro or Enterprise tier. Disable the Advanced power flow option of the integration; the power sensors are then based on 15-minute telemetry.

data_description.advanced_power_flow: Live power values from the Advanced Monitoring API (Business Pro or Enterprise tier, ~8,640 credits per month). When off, power values come from the latest 15 minutes of telemetry.
data_description.credit_budget: Credits per month this integration may use. The Free tier has 2,000 credits per month for the whole developer account.
data_description.update_interval: Minutes between updates, at least {min_interval}. 0 calculates the interval from the credit budget.

init.description: Current update interval: {interval} minutes, estimated usage: {credits} credits per month. Every successful API call costs 1 credit.
